title.raw: 卷三十六 志第十二 曆六 Volume 36 Treatises 12: Calendar 6

sentences.zh: 志第十二 歷六
大統曆法三下推步

translations.literal: Grand Concordance Calendar Method Three Lower: Stepwise Computation.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Grand Concordance Calendar Method, Part Three (Lower): Stepwise Computation.

sentences.zh: ▲步交食
交週日二十七日二十一刻二二二四。

translations.literal: Crossing-cycle day: twenty-seven days, twenty-one ke, 2224.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal period in days: 27d 21 quarter-hours 2224 parts.

sentences.zh: 半之爲交中日。

translations.literal: Halve it for crossing middle day.
translations.idiomatic: Halve this for the half-nodal interval in days.

sentences.zh: 交終度三百六十三度七九三四一九六。

translations.literal: Crossing termination degree: three hundred sixty-three degrees 7934196.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal arc for a complete cycle: 363.7934196°.

sentences.zh: 半之爲交中日度。

translations.literal: Halve it for crossing middle-day degree.
translations.idiomatic: Halve this for the half-nodal arc in degrees.

sentences.zh: 正交度三百五十七度六四。

translations.literal: Major-crossing degree: three hundred fifty-seven degrees 64.

sentences.zh: 中交度一百八十八度零五。

translations.literal: Middle-crossing degree: one hundred eighty-eight degrees 05.

sentences.zh: 前準一百六十六度三九六八。

translations.literal: Forward standard: one hundred sixty-six degrees 3968.

sentences.zh: 後準一十五度五。
交差二日三一八三六九。
交望一十四日七六五二九六五。
日食陽曆限六度。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse yang-calendar limit: six degrees.

sentences.zh: 定法六十。
日食陰曆限八度。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse yin-calendar limit: eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 定法八十。
月食十三度五分。
定法八十七。
陽食限視定朔入交。

translations.literal: Yang-eclipse limit inspects true new moon's entry into crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Solar-eclipse limit: inspect the true new moon's nodal entry.

sentences.zh: 零日六零已下 一十三日一零已上 在一十四日，不問小余，皆入食限。

translations.literal: Zero day 60 or below; thirteen day 10 or above—within fourteen days, regardless of small remainder, all enter eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: From 0d60 parts downward, or from 13d10 upward, through day 14 inclusive: regardless of fractional remainder, all fall within the solar-eclipse limit.

sentences.zh: 一十五日二零已下 二十五日六零已上 在二十六日、二十七日，不問小余，皆入食限。

translations.literal: Fifteen day 20 or below; twenty-five day 60 or above—within twenty-six and twenty-seven days, regardless of small remainder, all enter eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: From 15d20 downward, or from 25d60 upward, on days 26–27 regardless of fractional remainder: all within the limit.

sentences.zh: ▲陰食限視定望入交。

translations.literal: ▲ Yin-eclipse limit inspects true full moon's entry into crossing.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Lunar-eclipse limit: inspect the true full moon's nodal entry.

sentences.zh: 一日二零已下 一十二日四零已上 在零日一十三日，不問小余，皆入食限。

translations.literal: One day 20 or below; twelve day 40 or above—within zero and thirteen days, regardless of small remainder, all enter eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: From 1d20 downward, or from 12d40 upward, on days 0 and 13 regardless of fractional remainder: all within the limit.

sentences.zh: 又視定朔小余在日出前、日入後二十分已上者，日食在夜。

translations.literal: Also inspect true-new-moon small remainder twenty parts or more before sunrise or after sunset—solar eclipse at night.
translations.idiomatic: Also: if the true new moon's fractional day is 20 parts or more before sunrise, or after sunset, the solar eclipse occurs at night.

sentences.zh: 定望小余在日入前、日出後八刻二十分已上者，月食在晝。

translations.literal: True-full-moon small remainder eight ke twenty parts or more before sunset or after sunrise—lunar eclipse in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: If the true full moon's fractional day is 8 quarter-hours 20 parts or more before sunset, or after sunrise, the lunar eclipse occurs in daytime.

sentences.zh: 皆不必布算。

translations.literal: In all cases tabulation need not be deployed.
translations.idiomatic: None of these require full tabular computation.

sentences.zh: 推日食用數
推交常度 置有食之朔入交凡分，以月平行度乘之，即得。

translations.literal: Derive crossing mean degree: set the general parts of the eclipse lunation's entry into crossing; multiply by mean lunar travel—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the mean nodal longitude: set the general nodal-entry parts for the eclipse new moon, multiply by mean lunar motion, and the product is obtained.

sentences.zh: 推交定度 置交常度，以朔下盈縮差盈加縮減之，即得。

translations.literal: Derive crossing true degree: set crossing mean degree; with new-moon inferior expansion-contraction difference, surplus add and deficit subtract—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the true nodal longitude: set the mean value; add or subtract the sub-conjunction expansion–contraction difference (surplus add, deficit subtract).

sentences.zh: 推日食正交限度 視交定度在七度已下，三百四十一度已上者，食在正交。

translations.literal: Derive solar-eclipse major-crossing limit degree: if crossing true degree is seven degrees or below, three hundred forty-one degrees or above, eclipse at major crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the major-node eclipse limit: if true nodal longitude is ≤7° or ≥341°, the eclipse occurs at the major node.

sentences.zh: 在一百七十五度已上，二百零二度已下者，食在中交。

translations.literal: If one hundred seventy-five degrees or above and two hundred two degrees or below, eclipse at middle crossing.
translations.idiomatic: If between 175° and 202° inclusive, the eclipse is at the middle node.

sentences.zh: 不在限內不食。

translations.literal: If not within limits, no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Outside these bounds there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 推中前中後分 視定朔小余，在半日周已下，用減半日周，餘爲中前分。

translations.literal: Derive before-middle, middle, and after-middle parts: inspect true-new-moon small remainder; if below half-day circuit, use to subtract half-day circuit—remainder is before-middle part.
translations.idiomatic: Derive pre-noon, noon, and post-noon fractions: inspect the true new moon's fractional day; if below half the diurnal circuit, subtract from half the diurnal circuit—the remainder is the pre-noon fraction.

sentences.zh: 在半日周已上，減去半日周，餘爲中後分。

translations.literal: If above half-day circuit, subtract half-day circuit—remainder is after-middle part.
translations.idiomatic: If above half the diurnal circuit, subtract half the diurnal circuit—the remainder is the post-noon fraction.

sentences.zh: 推時差 置半日擊，以中前、中後分減之，餘以中後分乘之，所得以九千六百而一爲時差。

translations.literal: Derive time difference: set half-day product; subtract before-middle or after-middle parts; remainder multiplied by after-middle part; quotient divided by nine thousand six hundred is time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the hour equation: set the half-day divisor, subtract the pre- or post-noon fraction, multiply the remainder by the post-noon fraction, and divide by 9600 for the hour equation.

sentences.zh: 在中前爲減，中後爲加。

translations.literal: Before middle is subtract; after middle is add.
translations.idiomatic: Apply as subtraction before noon, addition after noon.

sentences.zh: 推食甚定分 置定朔小余，以時差加減之，即得。

translations.literal: Derive eclipse-greatest fixed part: set true-new-moon small remainder; add or subtract time difference—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the greatest-eclipse fractional day: set the true new moon's fractional day and apply the hour equation.

sentences.zh: 推距午定分 置中前、中後分，加時差即得。

translations.literal: Derive distance-from-noon fixed part: set before-middle or after-middle parts; add time difference—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the meridian-distance fraction: set the pre- or post-noon fraction and add the hour equation.

sentences.zh: 但加不減。
推食甚入盈縮歷 置原得盈縮歷，加入定朔大餘及食甚定分，即得。

translations.literal: Derive eclipse-greatest entry into expansion-contraction sequence: set the originally obtained expansion-contraction sequence; add fixed new-moon major remainder and eclipse-greatest fixed part—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Derive greatest-eclipse entry into the expansion–contraction sequence: set the prior sequence entry, add the true new moon's day count and greatest-eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 推食甚盈縮差 依步氣朔求之。

translations.literal: Derive eclipse-greatest expansion-contraction difference: seek by the qi-new-moon procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the greatest-eclipse expansion–contraction difference by the solar-term and lunation procedure.

sentences.zh: 推食甚入盈縮歷行定度 置食甚入盈縮歷，盈縮差，盈加縮減之，即得。

translations.literal: Derive eclipse-greatest entry into expansion-contraction sequence travel fixed degree: set eclipse-greatest entry into expansion-contraction sequence; expansion-contraction difference—surplus add deficit subtract—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the greatest-eclipse fixed solar longitude on the expansion–contraction track: set the sequence entry and apply the difference (surplus add, deficit subtract).

sentences.zh: 推南北凡差 視食甚人盈縮歷行定度，在周天象限已下爲初限，已上與半歲周相減爲末限。

translations.literal: Derive north-south general difference: inspect eclipse-greatest entry into expansion-contraction sequence travel fixed degree; below circumpolar image limit is initial limit, above—subtract from half-year circuit for terminal limit.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the general north–south parallax: inspect the fixed solar longitude at greatest eclipse; below the circumpolar image limit is the initial limit, above it subtract from half the tropical year for the terminal limit.

sentences.zh: 以初末限自之，如一千八百七十度而一，得數，置四度四十六分減之，餘爲南北凡差。

translations.literal: Square initial and terminal limits, divide by one thousand eight hundred seventy for the number; set four degrees forty-six minutes and subtract—remainder is north-south general difference.
translations.idiomatic: Square the active limit, divide by 1870; subtract the result from 4°46′—the remainder is the general north–south parallax.

sentences.zh: 推南北定差 置南北凡差，以距午定分乘之，如半晝分而一，以減凡差，餘爲南北定差。

translations.literal: Derive north-south true difference: set north-south general difference; multiply by distance-from-noon fixed part; divide by half-daylight part; subtract from general difference—remainder is north-south true difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the true north–south parallax: multiply the general value by the meridian-distance fraction, halve by the half-daylight fraction, subtract from the general value—the remainder is the true parallax.

sentences.zh: 若凡差數少，即反減之。

translations.literal: If general-difference number is small, then reverse-subtract instead.
translations.idiomatic: When the general value is small, reverse the subtraction.

sentences.zh: 盈初縮末食在正交爲減，中交爲加。

translations.literal: Surplus at initial, deficit at terminal—eclipse at major crossing is subtract, at middle crossing is add.
translations.idiomatic: At initial surplus and terminal deficit: subtract at the major node, add at the middle node.

sentences.zh: 縮初盈末，食在正交爲加，中交爲減。

translations.literal: Deficit at initial, surplus at terminal—eclipse at major crossing is add, at middle crossing is subtract.
translations.idiomatic: At initial deficit and terminal surplus: add at the major node, subtract at the middle node.

sentences.zh: 如系凡差反減而得者，則其加減反是。

translations.literal: If following a general difference obtained by reverse-subtraction, then the add-subtract is likewise reversed.
translations.idiomatic: When the general value required reverse subtraction, reverse the addition and subtraction rules accordingly.

sentences.zh: 推東西凡差 置半歲周，減去食甚入盈縮歷行定度，餘食甚入盈縮歷行定度乘之，以一千八百七十除之爲度，即東西凡差。

translations.literal: Derive east-west general difference: set half-year circuit; subtract eclipse-greatest entry into expansion-contraction travel fixed degree; multiply remainder by eclipse-greatest entry into expansion-contraction travel fixed degree; divide by one thousand eight hundred seventy for degrees—that is east-west general difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the general east–west parallax: set half the tropical year, subtract the fixed solar longitude at greatest eclipse, multiply the remainder by that longitude, and divide by 1870 for degrees.

sentences.zh: 推東西定差 置東西凡差，以距午定分乘之，如二千五百度而一，視得數在東西凡差以下，即爲東西定差。

translations.literal: Derive east-west true difference: set east-west general difference; multiply by distance-from-noon fixed part; divide by two thousand five hundred; if result is below east-west general difference, that is east-west true difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the true east–west parallax: multiply the general value by the meridian-distance fraction and divide by 2500; if the quotient does not exceed the general value, it is the true parallax.

sentences.zh: 若在凡差已上，倍凡差減之，餘爲定差。

translations.literal: If above general difference, double general difference and subtract—remainder is true difference.
translations.idiomatic: If above the general value, subtract the quotient from twice the general value—the remainder is the true parallax.

sentences.zh: 盈歷中前，縮歷 後者，正交減，中交加。

translations.literal: Expansion sequence before middle, contraction sequence after—major crossing subtract, middle crossing add.
translations.idiomatic: Expansion sequence before noon, contraction after: subtract at the major node, add at the middle node.

sentences.zh: 盈歷中後，縮中前者，正交加，中交減。

translations.literal: Expansion sequence after middle, contraction before middle—major crossing add, middle crossing subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Expansion after noon, contraction before: add at the major node, subtract at the middle node.

sentences.zh: 推正交中定限度 視日食在正交者置正交度，在中交者置中交度，以南北東西二定差加減之，即得。

translations.literal: Derive major-crossing and middle-crossing true limit degree: for major-crossing eclipse set major-crossing degree, for middle-crossing set middle-crossing degree; add or subtract the two true north-south and east-west differences—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the true major- or middle-node limit: for major-node eclipses set the major-node degree, for middle-node set the middle-node degree, then apply the true north–south and east–west parallaxes.

sentences.zh: 推日食入陰陽曆去閃前後度 視交定在正交定限度已下，減去交定度，餘爲陰曆交前度。

translations.literal: Derive solar eclipse's entry into yin-yang calendar degrees before and after gleam: if crossing true degree is below major-crossing true limit degree, subtract crossing true degree—remainder is yin-calendar before-crossing degree.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the solar eclipse's yang/yin-calendar offset before and after the penumbral gleam: if true nodal longitude is below the major-node true limit, subtract it—the remainder is the yin-calendar pre-node arc.

sentences.zh: 已上，減去正交定限度，餘爲陽曆交後度。

translations.literal: If above, subtract major-crossing true limit degree—remainder is yang-calendar after-crossing degree.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract the major-node true limit—the remainder is the yang-calendar post-node arc.

sentences.zh: 在中交定限度已下，減去交定度，餘爲陽曆閃前度。

translations.literal: If below middle-crossing true limit degree, subtract crossing true degree—remainder is yang-calendar before-gleam degree.
translations.idiomatic: If below the middle-node true limit, subtract the true nodal longitude—the remainder is the yang-calendar pre-gleam arc.

sentences.zh: 已上，減去中交定限度，餘爲陰曆後度。

translations.literal: If above, subtract middle-crossing true limit degree—remainder is yin-calendar after degree.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract the middle-node true limit—the remainder is the yin-calendar post-node arc.

sentences.zh: 若交定在七度已下者加交終度，減去正交定限度，餘爲陽曆交後度。

translations.literal: If crossing true degree is seven degrees or below, add crossing termination degree and subtract major-crossing true limit degree—remainder is yang-calendar after-crossing degree.
translations.idiomatic: If true nodal longitude is ≤7°, add the nodal-cycle arc and subtract the major-node true limit—the remainder is the yang-calendar post-node arc.

sentences.zh: 推日食分秒 在陽曆者，置陽食限六度，減去陽曆交前、交後度，不及減者，不食。

translations.literal: Derive solar-eclipse parts and seconds: in yang-calendar, set yang-eclipse limit six degrees; subtract yang-calendar before- and after-crossing degrees; if subtraction fails, no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the solar-eclipse magnitude: in the yang calendar, set the 6° yang limit and subtract the pre- and post-node yang arcs; if subtraction fails, there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 陰曆同。

translations.idiomatic: The yin-calendar case is the same.

sentences.zh: 餘以定法六十而一。

translations.literal: Remainder divided by fixing divisor sixty.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the remainder by the standardizing divisor 60.

sentences.zh: 在陰曆者，置陰食限八度，減去陰曆交前、交後度，餘以定法八十而一，即得。

translations.literal: In yin-calendar, set yin-eclipse limit eight degrees; subtract yin-calendar before- and after-crossing degrees; remainder divided by fixing divisor eighty—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In the yin calendar, set the 8° yin limit, subtract the pre- and post-node yin arcs, and divide the remainder by 80 to obtain the magnitude.

sentences.zh: 推定用分 置日食分秒與二十分相減相乘，爲開方積。

translations.literal: Derive fixed-use part: set solar-eclipse parts and seconds and twenty parts—subtract and multiply for square-root product.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the fixed duration fraction: set the eclipse magnitude and 20 parts, subtract and multiply to form the square-root product.

sentences.zh: 以平方法開之，爲開方數。

translations.literal: Extract square root by mean-square method—this is the square-root number.
translations.idiomatic: Take the square root by the mean-square method to obtain the root value.

sentences.zh: 用五千七百四十分七因八百二十分也。

translations.literal: Use five thousand seven hundred forty parts—seven times eight hundred twenty parts.

sentences.zh: 乘之，如定限行度而一，即得。

translations.literal: Multiply it; divide by fixed travel limit degree—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply, then divide by the fixed travel-limit degree to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 推初虧復圓時刻 置食甚定分，以定用分減爲初虧，加爲復圓。

translations.literal: Derive first-deficit and last-fullness hour-ke: set eclipse-greatest fixed part; subtract fixed-use part for first-deficit, add for last-fullness.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the first-contact and last-contact fractional hours: set the greatest-eclipse fraction; subtract the fixed duration for first contact, add for last contact.

sentences.zh: 各依發斂加時，即時刻。

translations.literal: Each according to emission-contraction add time—then the hour-ke.
translations.idiomatic: Apply emission-and-gathering to each to obtain the clock time.

sentences.zh: 推日食起復方位 陽曆初虧西南，甚於正南，復於東南。

translations.literal: Derive solar-eclipse beginning and ending direction: yang-calendar first-deficit southwest, greatest at due south, last-fullness southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Derive solar-eclipse contact azimuths: yang calendar—first contact southwest, greatest due south, last contact southeast.

sentences.zh: 陰曆初虧西北，甚於正北，復於東北。

translations.literal: Yin-calendar first-deficit northwest, greatest at due north, last-fullness northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Yin calendar—first contact northwest, greatest due north, last contact northeast.

sentences.zh: 若在八分以上，不分陰陽曆皆虧正西，復東位。

translations.literal: If eight parts or more in degree, regardless of yin-yang calendar all first-deficit due west, last-fullness east position.
translations.idiomatic: If the magnitude reaches 0.8° or more, regardless of calendar branch, first contact is due west and last contact due east.

sentences.zh: 據午地而論

translations.literal: Discussed with respect to the noon position.
translations.idiomatic: Reckoned from the local meridian at noon.

sentences.zh: 推食甚日躔黃道宿次 置食甚入盈縮歷行定度，在盈就爲定積度，在縮加半歲周爲定積度。

translations.literal: Derive greatest-eclipse sun's ecliptic lodge position: set eclipse-greatest entry into expansion-contraction travel fixed degree; if in surplus it is the fixed accumulated degree, if in deficit add half-year circuit for fixed accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the Sun's ecliptic lodge at greatest eclipse: set the fixed solar longitude at greatest eclipse; in surplus it is the fixed accumulation, in deficit add half the tropical year.

sentences.zh: 置定積度，以歲前冬至加時黃道日度加之，滿黃道積度鈐去之，至不滿宿次即食甚日躔。

translations.literal: Set fixed accumulated degree; add the winter-solstice-before-year hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree; when full remove by ecliptic accumulated-degree tally—down to not filling a lodge, that is greatest-eclipse sun's progression.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed accumulation, add the ecliptic solar longitude at the pre-year winter solstice hour, discard the ecliptic cycle when full, and the lodge not yet filled is the Sun's position at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 推日帶食 視初虧食甚分，有在日出分已下，爲晨刻帶食。

translations.literal: Derive solar accompanying-eclipse: inspect first-deficit and greatest-eclipse parts; if any are below sunrise part, it is dawn-ke accompanying-eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Derive a solar eclipse at sunrise or sunset: if first contact or greatest eclipse falls below the sunrise fraction, it is a dawn eclipse at sunrise.

sentences.zh: 食甚復圓分，有在日入分已上，爲昏刻帶食。

translations.literal: Greatest-eclipse and last-fullness parts; if any are above sunset part, it is dusk-ke accompanying-eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse or last contact falls above the sunset fraction, it is a dusk eclipse at sunset.

sentences.zh: 在晨置日出分，在昏昏置日入分，皆以食甚分與之相減，餘爲帶食差。

translations.literal: At dawn set sunrise part; at dusk set sunset part; in all cases subtract eclipse-greatest part from them—remainder is accompanying-eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn set the sunrise fraction; at dusk set the sunset fraction; subtract the greatest-eclipse fraction in each case—the remainder is the horizon-eclipse offset.

sentences.zh: 置帶帶差，以日食分秒乘之，以定用分而一，所得減日食分秒，餘爲所見帶食分秒。

translations.literal: Set accompanying-eclipse difference; multiply by solar-eclipse parts and seconds; divide by fixed-use part; product subtracted from solar-eclipse parts and seconds—remainder is the observed accompanying-eclipse parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the horizon-eclipse offset, multiply by the eclipse magnitude, divide by the fixed duration fraction, and subtract from the magnitude—the remainder is the visible horizon-eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: ▲推月食用數
盈縮歷
盈縮差
遲疾歷
遲疾差
加減差
入交凡分
定入遲疾歷

translations.idiomatic: Fixed entry into the slow–rapid sequence

sentences.zh: 定限行度
日出分
日入分
▲歲前冬至加時黃道宿次

translations.idiomatic: ▲ Ecliptic lodge at the pre-year winter solstice hour of addition

sentences.zh: 推交常度 置望下入交凡分，乘月平行，如日食法。

translations.literal: Derive crossing mean degree: set full-moon inferior entry into crossing general parts; multiply mean lunar travel—as in the solar-eclipse method.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the mean nodal longitude: set the general nodal-entry parts below the full moon, multiply by mean lunar motion, as for solar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 推交定度 置交常度，以望下盈縮差盈加縮減之即得。

translations.literal: Derive crossing true degree: set crossing mean degree; with full-moon inferior expansion-contraction difference, surplus add deficit subtract—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the true nodal longitude: set the mean value; add or subtract the sub-full-moon expansion–contraction difference (surplus add, deficit subtract).

sentences.zh: 不及減者，加交終度減之。

translations.literal: If subtraction is insufficient, add crossing termination degree and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, add the nodal-cycle arc and subtract again.

sentences.zh: 推食甚定分 不用時差，即以定望分爲食甚分。

translations.literal: Derive greatest-eclipse fixed part: do not use time difference; directly take true-full-moon part as greatest-eclipse part.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the greatest-eclipse fraction: omit the hour equation; take the true full moon's fractional day directly as the greatest-eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 推食甚入盈縮歷行定度 法同推日食。

translations.literal: Derive greatest-eclipse entry into expansion-contraction travel fixed degree: method same as deriving solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the greatest-eclipse fixed solar longitude on the expansion–contraction track: same procedure as for solar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 推月食入陰陽曆 視交定度在交中度已下爲陽曆，已上減去交中度，餘爲隊歷。

translations.literal: Derive lunar eclipse's entry into yin-yang calendar: if crossing true degree is below middle-crossing degree it is yang-calendar; if above, subtract middle-crossing degree—remainder is troop-calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the lunar eclipse's yang/yin calendar branch: if true nodal longitude is below the middle-node degree it is the yang calendar; if above, subtract the middle-node degree—the remainder is the yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 推交前交後度 視所得入陰陽曆，在後準已下爲交後，在前準已上置交中度減之，餘爲交前。

translations.literal: Derive before-crossing and after-crossing degrees: inspect the yin-yang calendar obtained; if below backward standard it is after-crossing; if above forward standard, set middle-crossing degree and subtract—remainder is before-crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the pre- and post-node arcs: inspect the yang/yin branch obtained; if below the backward criterion it is post-node; if above the forward criterion, set the middle-node degree and subtract—the remainder is pre-node.

sentences.zh: 推月食分秒 置月食限一十三度零五，減去前交後度，不及減者不食。

translations.literal: To seek lunar-eclipse parts and seconds: set the lunar-eclipse limit of 13 degrees 0.5, subtract the pre- and post-crossing degree; if it cannot be subtracted, there is no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse magnitude: set the lunar eclipse limit at 13°0.5 and subtract the pre- or post-node degree; if subtraction fails, there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 餘以定法八十七分而一，即得。

translations.literal: With the remainder, divide by the fixed divisor of 87 parts—then it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the remainder by the fixed divisor of 87 parts to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 推月食用分 置三十分，與月食分秒相減相乘，爲開方積。

translations.literal: To seek lunar-eclipse usable parts: set 30 parts; with lunar-eclipse parts and seconds subtract and multiply for the square-root product.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse usable parts: set 30 parts, then subtract and cross-multiply with the eclipse magnitude to form the square-root product.

sentences.zh: 依平方法開之，爲開方數。

translations.literal: Open it by the leveling method—this is the square-root number.
translations.idiomatic: Extract the square root by the standard method to obtain the root number.

sentences.zh: 又以四千九百二十乃六因八百二十分數。

translations.idiomatic: Multiply again by 4920, which is six times the 820-part factor.

sentences.zh: 分乘之，如定限行度而一，即得。

translations.literal: Multiply by it; as the fixed-limit travel degrees to one—then it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by that value and scale by the fixed-limit travel degrees to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 推月食三限初虧、食甚、復圓。

translations.literal: To seek the lunar eclipse's three limits: first loss, greatest eclipse, and last contact.
translations.idiomatic: To find the three lunar eclipse limits: first contact, greatest eclipse, and last contact.

sentences.zh: 時刻 置食甚分定分，以用分減爲初虧，加爲復圓。

translations.literal: Time: set the greatest-eclipse fixed parts; subtract the usable parts for first loss, add for last contact.
translations.idiomatic: For the times: set the greatest-eclipse fixed parts; subtract the usable parts for first contact and add them for last contact.

sentences.zh: 依發斂得時刻如日食。

translations.literal: Obtain the time by emission and collection, as for solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the clock time by emission and collection, as for a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 推月食五限時刻 月食十分已上者，用五限推之，初虧、食既、食甚、生光、復圓也。

translations.literal: To seek lunar-eclipse five-limit times: when the lunar eclipse is 10 tenths or above, use the five limits—first loss, totality, greatest eclipse, emergence of light, and last contact.
translations.idiomatic: To find the five-limit times for a lunar eclipse: when the eclipse magnitude is 10 tenths or greater, apply the five limits—first contact, totality, greatest eclipse, emergence of light, and last contact.

sentences.zh: 置月食分秒，減去十分，餘與十分相減相乘，爲開方積。

translations.literal: Set lunar-eclipse parts and seconds; subtract 10 tenths; with the remainder subtract and multiply by 10 tenths for the square-root product.
translations.idiomatic: Set the lunar eclipse magnitude, subtract 10 tenths, and with the remainder cross-multiply by 10 tenths to form the square-root product.

sentences.zh: 平方開之，爲開方數。

translations.literal: Open the square—this is the square-root number.
translations.idiomatic: Take the square root to obtain the root number.

sentences.zh: 又以四千九百二十分乘之，如定限行度而一爲既內分。

translations.literal: Again multiply by 4920 parts; as the fixed-limit travel degrees to one—this is the inner-totality parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply again by 4920 parts and scale by the fixed-limit travel degrees to obtain the inner-totality parts.

sentences.zh: 與定用分相減，餘爲既外分。

translations.literal: Subtract from the fixed usable parts; the remainder is the outer-totality parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the fixed usable parts; the remainder gives the outer-totality parts.

sentences.zh: 置食甚定分，減既內分爲既分，又減既外分爲初虧分。

translations.literal: Set the greatest-eclipse fixed parts; subtract the inner-totality parts for the totality parts, and again subtract the outer-totality parts for the first-loss parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the greatest-eclipse fixed parts; subtract the inner-totality parts for totality, then subtract the outer-totality parts for first contact.

sentences.zh: 再置食甚定分，加既內分爲生光分，又加既外分爲復圓分。

translations.literal: Again set the greatest-eclipse fixed parts; add the inner-totality parts for emergence-of-light parts, and again add the outer-totality parts for last-contact parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the greatest-eclipse fixed parts again; add the inner-totality parts for emergence of light, then add the outer-totality parts for last contact.

sentences.zh: 各依以斂得時刻。

translations.literal: Each by emission and collection obtains the time.
translations.idiomatic: Convert each limit to clock time by emission and collection.

sentences.zh: 推更點 置晨分們之，五分之爲更法，又五分之爲點法。

translations.literal: To seek the night watches and marks: set the dawn parts and halve them for the watch divisor; halve again for the mark divisor.
translations.idiomatic: To find the night watches and marks: set the dawn parts and halve them for the watch divisor, then halve again for the mark divisor.

sentences.zh: 推月食入更點 各置三限或五限，在昏分已上減去昏分，在晨分已下加入晨分，不滿更法爲初更，不滿點法爲一點，以次求之，各得更點之數。

translations.literal: To seek lunar eclipse entry into watches and marks: for each of the three or five limits, if above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; if below dawn parts add dawn parts; what does not fill the watch divisor is the first watch, what does not fill the mark divisor is the first mark—seek in succession to obtain each watch and mark number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the eclipse's watch and mark: for each three- or five-limit time, subtract dusk parts if above dusk, add dawn parts if below dawn; the remainder modulo the watch divisor gives the watch, modulo the mark divisor gives the mark—continue in sequence for each limit.

sentences.zh: 推月食起復方位 陽曆初虧東北，甚於正北，復於西北。

translations.literal: To seek lunar-eclipse beginning and ending direction: in the yang sequence, first loss is northeast, greatest at due north, last contact northwest.
translations.idiomatic: To find the eclipse's beginning and ending azimuth: in the yang sequence, first contact lies northeast, greatest at due north, and last contact northwest.

sentences.zh: 陰曆初虧東南，甚於正南，復於西南。

translations.literal: In the yin sequence, first loss is southeast, greatest at due south, last contact southwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the yin sequence, first contact lies southeast, greatest at due south, and last contact southwest.

sentences.zh: 若食在八分已上者，皆初虧正東，復於正西。

translations.literal: If the eclipse is 8 tenths or above, all have first loss due east and last contact due west.
translations.idiomatic: When the eclipse reaches 8 tenths or more, first contact is due east and last contact due west in every case.

sentences.zh: 推食甚月離黃道宿次 置食甚入盈縮歷定度，在盈加半周天，在縮減去七十五秒爲定積度。

translations.literal: To seek the greatest-eclipse Moon's lodge on the ecliptic: set the greatest-eclipse entry into the expansion-contraction ephemeris fixed degree; in expansion add half the celestial circuit, in contraction subtract 75 seconds for the fixed accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the Moon's ecliptic lodge at greatest eclipse: set the greatest-eclipse entry into the expansion–contraction ephemeris fixed degree; in expansion add half the celestial circuit, in contraction subtract 75 seconds to obtain the fixed accumulated degree.

sentences.zh: 置定積度，加歲前冬至加時黃道日度，以黃道積度鈐去之，即得。

translations.literal: Set the fixed accumulated degree; add the ecliptic solar degree at the winter solstice before the year at time-of-day; remove by the ecliptic accumulated-degree tally—then it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed accumulated degree, add the ecliptic solar degree at the prior year's winter solstice moment, and subtract successive entries from the ecliptic accumulation tally to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 推月帶食 視初虧、食甚、復圓等分，在日入分以下，爲昏刻帶食。

translations.literal: To seek the Moon accompanying the eclipse: inspect the parts of first loss, greatest eclipse, and last contact; if below sunset parts, it is dusk-watch eclipse-accompaniment.
translations.idiomatic: To determine whether the Moon rises or sets during the eclipse: if first contact, greatest eclipse, or last contact falls below the sunset parts, the eclipse accompanies dusk.

sentences.zh: 在日出分已上，爲晨刻帶食。

translations.literal: If above sunrise parts, it is dawn-watch eclipse-accompaniment.
translations.idiomatic: If it falls above the sunrise parts, the eclipse accompanies dawn.

sentences.zh: 推法同日食。

translations.literal: The method is the same as for solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure matches that for solar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 推五星前後合 置中積，加合應，滿周率去之，餘爲前合。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the five planets' prior and subsequent conjunctions: Set the central accumulation, add the conjunction correspondence, and when full remove by the cycle rate; the remainder is the prior conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the five planets' prior and subsequent conjunctions: set the central accumulation, add the conjunction correspondence, and when full discard the cycle rate; the remainder is the prior conjunction.

sentences.zh: 再置周率，以前合減之，於爲後合。

translations.literal: Set the cycle rate again; subtract the prior conjunction from it—what remains is the subsequent conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Set the cycle rate again and subtract the prior conjunction; the remainder is the subsequent conjunction.

sentences.zh: 如滿歲周去之，即其年無後合分。

translations.literal: If it fills the year circuit, remove it—then that year has no subsequent-conjunction fraction.
translations.idiomatic: If the result fills the year circuit, discard it—then that year has no subsequent-conjunction remainder.

sentences.zh: 推五星中積日中星度 置各星後合，既爲合伏下中積中星。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the five planets' central-accumulation days and mean star positions: Set each planet's subsequent conjunction; this already serves as the mean accumulation and mean star beneath conjunction concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the five planets' central-accumulation days and mean star positions: set each planet's subsequent conjunction, which already serves as the mean accumulation and mean star at conjunction concealment.

sentences.zh: 命爲日，曰中積。

translations.literal: Designate it as days—called the central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Count it as days—this is the central accumulation.

sentences.zh: 命爲度，曰中星。

translations.literal: Designate it as degrees—called the mean star.
translations.idiomatic: Count it as degrees—this is the mean star.

sentences.zh: 累加段日，爲各段中積。

translations.literal: Accumulate segment days to obtain each segment's central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate segment days to obtain each segment's central accumulation.

sentences.zh: 皆滿歲周去之。

translations.literal: In each case, when full remove by the year circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever full, discard the year circuit.

sentences.zh: 以各段下平度，累加各段下平度，滿歲周去。

translations.literal: With each segment's lower mean degree, accumulate the lower mean degrees of each segment; when full remove by the year circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate each segment's lower mean degree; when full, discard the year circuit.

sentences.zh: 退則減之，不及減，加歲周減之。

translations.literal: If retrograde, subtract; if subtraction is insufficient, add the year circuit and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: In retrograde motion subtract; if subtraction falls short, add the year circuit and subtract.

sentences.zh: 次復累加之，爲各段中星。

translations.literal: Accumulate again in succession to obtain each segment's mean star.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate again in succession to obtain each segment's mean star.

sentences.zh: 推五星盈縮歷 置中積，加歷應及生合，滿歷率去之，餘以度率而一爲度。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the five planets' expansion-contraction sequence: Set the central accumulation, add the ephemeris correspondence and natal conjunction; when full remove by the ephemeris rate; divide the remainder by the degree rate to one for degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the five planets' expansion–contraction sequence: set the central accumulation, add the ephemeris correspondence and natal conjunction, discard the ephemeris rate when full, and divide the remainder by the degree rate to obtain degrees.

sentences.zh: 在歷中已下爲盈，已上減去歷中爲縮。

translations.literal: Below the ephemeris midpoint is expansion; above, subtract the ephemeris midpoint for contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Below the ephemeris midpoint counts as expansion; above it, subtract the ephemeris midpoint to obtain contraction.

sentences.zh: 置各星合伏下盈縮歷，以段下限度累加之之滿歷中去之，盈交縮，縮交盈，即各段盈縮歷。

translations.literal: Set each planet's expansion-contraction sequence beneath conjunction concealment; accumulate adding the limit beneath each segment, and when full remove by the ephemeris rate; where expansion meets contraction becomes contraction, and contraction meets expansion—then each segment's expansion-contraction sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Set each planet's expansion–contraction sequence at conjunction concealment, accumulate the limit beneath each segment, and discard the ephemeris rate when full; expansion crossing contraction becomes contraction and contraction crossing expansion becomes expansion—yielding each segment's expansion–contraction sequence.

sentences.zh: 推五星盈縮差 置各段盈縮歷，以歷策除之爲策數，不盡，爲策餘。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the five planets' expansion-contraction difference: Set each segment's expansion-contraction sequence; divide by the ephemeris seed for seed count; what does not divide is the seed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the five planets' expansion–contraction difference: set each segment's expansion–contraction sequence, divide by the ephemeris seed for the seed count, and treat the remainder as the seed remainder.

sentences.zh: 以其下損益分見立成。

translations.literal: From the decrease-increase parts shown beneath it in the ready reckoner, take them.
translations.idiomatic: Take the decrease-and-increase parts shown beneath it in the ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 乘之，以歷策而一，所得益加損減其盈縮積分，即盈縮差。

translations.literal: Multiply; divide by the ephemeris seed to one; what is obtained—add in expansion, subtract in contraction from its expansion-contraction accumulated parts—this is the expansion-contraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply, divide by the ephemeris seed, and add the product in expansion or subtract it in contraction from the expansion–contraction accumulated parts to obtain the expansion–contraction difference.

sentences.zh: 金星倍之，水星三之。

translations.literal: For Venus double it; for Mercury triple it.
translations.idiomatic: Double the result for Venus; triple it for Mercury.

sentences.zh: 推定積日 置各段中積，以其段盈縮差盈加縮減之，即得。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the fixed accumulated day: Set each segment's central accumulation; with that segment's expansion-contraction difference, add in expansion and subtract in contraction—then it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the fixed accumulated day: set each segment's central accumulation and, with that segment's expansion–contraction difference, add in expansion and subtract in contraction.

sentences.zh: 滿歲周去之，如中積不及減者，加歲周減之。

translations.literal: When full remove by the year circuit; if the central accumulation is insufficient to subtract, add the year circuit and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Discard the year circuit when full; if the central accumulation cannot be reduced, add the year circuit and subtract.

sentences.zh: 本段原無差者，借前段差加之，則金水二星，亦只用所得盈縮差，不用三之倍之。

translations.literal: If the present segment originally has no difference, borrow the prior segment's difference and add; then for Venus and Mercury one still uses only the expansion-contraction difference obtained, without tripling or doubling.
translations.idiomatic: If a segment originally has no difference, borrow the prior segment's difference and add it; for Venus and Mercury, use only the expansion–contraction difference obtained, without doubling or tripling.

sentences.zh: 推加時定日 置定積日，以歲前天正冬至分加之，滿紀法去之，餘命甲子算外，即爲定日。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the time-of-addition fixed day: Set the fixed accumulated day, add the parts of the winter solstice before the year's heavenly standard, when full remove by the era rule, and with the remainder count off from jiazi outside the count—the result is the fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the time-of-addition fixed day: set the fixed accumulated day, add the parts of the prior year's heavenly-standard winter solstice, discard the era rule when full, and count the remainder from jiazi outside the count to obtain the fixed day.

sentences.zh: 視定積日會滿歲周去者，用本年冬至，會加歲周減者，用歲前冬至。

translations.literal: If the fixed accumulated day happens to fill the year circuit and is removed, use this year's winter solstice; if it meets adding the year circuit and subtracting, use the winter solstice before the year.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed accumulated day fills the year circuit and is discarded, use this year's winter solstice; if it requires adding the year circuit and subtracting, use the prior year's winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 推所入月日 置合伏下定積，以加天正閏餘滿朔策除之，爲月數。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the month and day entered: Set the fixed accumulation beneath conjunction concealment; add the intercalary remainder of heaven's standard and when full divide by the new-moon stride for month count.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the month and day entered: set the fixed accumulation at conjunction concealment, add the intercalary remainder of the heavenly standard, and when full divide by the new-moon stride to obtain the month count.

sentences.zh: 起歲前十一月，其不滿朔策者，即入月已來日分也。

translations.literal: Count from the eleventh month before the year; what does not fill the new-moon stride is the days elapsed within the month entered.
translations.idiomatic: Count from the eleventh month before the year; the remainder short of the new-moon stride is the days elapsed within the month entered.

sentences.zh: 視其月定朔甲子，與加時定日甲子相去即合伏日，累加相距日，滿各月大小去之，即各段所入月日。

translations.literal: Inspect that month's fixed-new-moon jiazi and the interval to the time-of-addition fixed day's jiazi—that is the conjunction-concealment day; accumulate the intervening days, and when each month's long/short month rule is full remove it—the result is the month and day entered for each segment.
translations.idiomatic: Compare that month's fixed-new-moon jiazi with the time-of-addition fixed day's jiazi to obtain the conjunction-concealment day; accumulate intervening days and discard each month's long-or-short month allowance when full to obtain the month and day entered for each segment.

sentences.zh: 推定星 置各段中星，依推定積日法，以盈縮差加減之。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the fixed star: Set each segment's mean star; by the procedure for deriving the fixed accumulated day, add and subtract the expansion-contraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the fixed star: set each segment's mean star and, by the fixed-accumulated-day procedure, add or subtract the expansion–contraction difference.

sentences.zh: 推加時定星 置定星，以歲前冬至加時黃道日度加之，滿週歲天去之。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the time-of-addition fixed star: Set the fixed star, add the ecliptic solar degree at the prior year's winter solstice time-of-addition, and when full remove by the circuit-of-year heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the time-of-addition fixed star: set the fixed star, add the ecliptic solar degree at the prior year's winter-solstice moment, and discard the circuit-of-year heaven when full.

sentences.zh: 若定積日會加歲周者，用歲前黃道日度。

translations.literal: If the fixed accumulated day meets adding the year circuit, use the prior year's ecliptic solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed accumulated day requires adding the year circuit, use the prior year's ecliptic solar degree.

sentences.zh: 遇減歲周者，用本年黃道目度，如原無中星度，段下亦無定星星及加時定星度分。

translations.literal: When meeting subtraction of the year circuit, use this year's ecliptic solar degree; if there was originally no mean-star degree, beneath the segment there are also no fixed-star degrees or time-of-addition fixed-star degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: When the year circuit must be subtracted, use this year's ecliptic solar degree; if there was originally no mean-star degree, the segment lists neither fixed-star degrees nor time-of-addition fixed-star degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 推加減定分 置定日小余，以其段初行率乘之，滿萬爲分，所得諸段爲減分，退段爲加分。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the additive-subtractive fixed parts: Set the fixed day's small remainder, multiply by that segment's initial motion rate, and when full take 10,000 as parts; what is obtained—for prograde segments is subtractive parts, for retrograde segments additive parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the additive-subtractive fixed parts: set the fixed day's small remainder, multiply by that segment's initial motion rate, scale by ten thousand to obtain parts; prograde segments yield subtractive parts, retrograde segments additive parts.

sentences.zh: 推夜半定星及宿次 置加時定星，以加減定分加減之，爲夜半定星。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the midnight fixed star and lodge ordinal: Set the time-of-addition fixed star, add and subtract the additive-subtractive fixed parts, for the midnight fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the midnight fixed star and lodge ordinal: set the time-of-addition fixed star and add or subtract the additive-subtractive fixed parts to obtain the midnight fixed star.

sentences.zh: 以黃道積度鈐減之，爲夜半宿次。

translations.literal: Subtract successive entries from the ecliptic accumulated-degree dial to obtain the midnight lodge ordinal.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract successive entries from the ecliptic accumulated-degree dial to obtain the midnight lodge ordinal.

sentences.zh: 其留段即用時定星，爲夜半一星。

translations.literal: For station segments, use directly the time-of-addition fixed star as the midnight fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: For station segments, take the time-of-addition fixed star directly as the midnight fixed star.

sentences.zh: 推日度率 置各段定日，與次段定日相減爲日率。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the daily degree rate: Set each segment's fixed day and subtract the next segment's fixed day for the day rate.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the daily degree rate: subtract each segment's fixed day from the next segment's fixed day to obtain the day rate.

sentences.zh: 次段不及減，加紀法減之。

translations.literal: If the next segment is insufficient to subtract, add the era rule and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the next segment cannot be subtracted, add the era rule and subtract.

sentences.zh: 置各段夜半－定星，與次段夜半定星相減爲度漲。

translations.literal: Set each segment's midnight fixed star and subtract the next segment's midnight fixed star for the degree increment.
translations.idiomatic: Set each segment's midnight fixed star and subtract the next segment's midnight fixed star to obtain the degree increment.

sentences.zh: 次段不及減，加周天減之。

translations.literal: If the next segment is insufficient to subtract, add the celestial circuit and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the next segment cannot be subtracted, add the celestial circuit and subtract.

sentences.zh: 凡近留之段，皆用留段加時定星，與本段夜半定星相減。

translations.literal: For all segments near a station, use the station segment's time-of-addition fixed star and subtract this segment's midnight fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: For segments near a station, subtract this segment's midnight fixed star from the station segment's time-of-addition fixed star.

sentences.zh: 如星度逆者，以後段減前段，即各得度率。

translations.literal: If the star's motion is retrograde, subtract the prior segment from the later segment—then each yields its degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the star's motion is retrograde, subtract the earlier segment from the later one to obtain each degree rate.

sentences.zh: 推平行分 置度率，以日率除之，即得。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive parallel motion: Set the degree rate; divide by the day rate to obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive parallel motion: set the degree rate and divide by the day rate.

sentences.zh: 推凡差及增減總差日差 以本段前後之平行分相減，爲本段凡差。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive general difference and increase-decrease, total difference, and daily difference: Subtract the prior and subsequent parallel motion of this segment; the result is this segment's general difference.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the general difference, increase–decrease difference, total difference, and daily difference: subtract this segment's prior and subsequent parallel motion; the remainder is this segment's general difference.

sentences.zh: 凡五星之伏段及近留之遲段及退段，皆無凡差。

translations.literal: For all five planets, concealment segments and slow segments and retrograde segments near a station have no general difference.
translations.idiomatic: For all five planets, concealment segments, slow segments near station, and retrograde segments have no general difference.

sentences.zh: 倍凡差，退一位爲增減差。

translations.literal: Double the general difference; shift back one place for the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the general difference and shift back one decimal place to obtain the increase–decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 倍增減差爲總差。

translations.literal: Double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the increase–decrease difference to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 置總差，以日率減一日除之爲日差。

translations.literal: Set the total difference; divide by the day rate minus one day to obtain the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the total difference and divide by the day rate minus one day to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 初日行分多，爲減差。

translations.literal: If the initial day's motion parts are greater, it is a subtractive difference.
translations.idiomatic: If the initial day's motion parts are greater, the correction is subtractive.

sentences.zh: 末日行分多，爲加差。

translations.literal: If the final day's motion parts are greater, it is an additive difference.
translations.idiomatic: If the final day's motion parts are greater, the correction is additive.

sentences.zh: 推初日行分末日行分 以增減差加減其段平行分，爲初末日行分。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive initial-day and final-day motion parts: Add or subtract the increase-decrease difference from this segment's parallel motion to obtain initial and final day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive initial-day and final-day motion parts: add or subtract the increase–decrease difference from this segment's parallel motion.

sentences.zh: 視本段平行分與次段平行分相較，前多後少者，加爲初，減爲末。

translations.literal: Compare this segment's parallel motion with the next segment's parallel motion; if prior is more and subsequent less, add for initial and subtract for final.
translations.idiomatic: Compare this segment's parallel motion with the next segment's: if the prior exceeds the subsequent, add for the initial day and subtract for the final day.

sentences.zh: 前少後多者，減爲初，加爲末。

translations.literal: If prior is less and subsequent more, subtract for initial and add for final.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior is less and the subsequent more, subtract for the initial day and add for the final day.

sentences.zh: 推撫心差諸段爲增減差總差日差 合伏者，置次段初日行分，加其日差之半，亦次段日差。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive heart-smoothing difference segments as increase-decrease, total difference, and daily difference—For conjunction concealment: set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, add half its daily difference—that also is the next segment's daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive heart-smoothing difference for segments as increase–decrease, total, and daily differences—at conjunction concealment: set the next segment's initial-day motion parts and add half its daily difference, which is also the next segment's daily difference.

sentences.zh: 爲末日行分。

translations.literal: This is the final-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 晨伏、夕伏者，置前段本段之前。

translations.literal: For morning concealment and evening concealment, set the prior segment before this segment.
translations.idiomatic: For morning concealment and evening concealment, set the segment before this one.

sentences.zh: 末日行分，加其日差之半，亦前段日差。

translations.literal: Final-day motion parts, add half its daily difference—that also is the prior segment's daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the final-day motion parts and add half the daily difference, which is also the prior segment's daily difference.

sentences.zh: 爲二伏初日行分。

translations.literal: This is the initial-day motion parts of the two concealments.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the initial-day motion parts for the two concealments.

sentences.zh: 置伏段呼得初末日行分，皆與本段平行分相減，餘爲增減差。

translations.literal: Set the concealment segment's obtained initial and final day motion parts; in each case subtract from this segment's parallel motion; remainder is increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the concealment segment's initial and final day motion parts obtained by calculation; subtract each from this segment's parallel motion; the remainder is the increase–decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 又以增差加 減平行分，爲初末日行分。

translations.literal: Again with increase difference add and subtract parallel motion for initial and final day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Again add or subtract the increase–decrease difference from parallel motion to obtain initial and final day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 視合伏末日行全較平行分，少則加，多則減，爲初日行分。

translations.literal: Compare conjunction-concealment final-day motion parts with parallel motion; if less then add, if more then subtract—for initial-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Compare conjunction-concealment final-day motion parts with parallel motion: if less, add; if more, subtract—to obtain initial-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 晨伏、夕伏初日行分較平行分，亦少加多減，爲末日行分。

translations.literal: Morning and evening concealment initial-day motion parts compared with parallel motion—likewise add if less and subtract if more—for final-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For morning and evening concealment, compare initial-day motion parts with parallel motion and likewise add if less or subtract if more to obtain final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 木、火之晨遲末，土之晨遲，金之夕遲末，水之夕遲，皆置其前末日行分，銳其日差減之，即前段日差。

translations.literal: Jupiter and Mars morning slow final, Saturn morning slow, Venus evening slow final, Mercury evening slow—all set their prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract the refined daily difference—that is the prior segment's daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter and Mars at morning slow final, Saturn at morning slow, Venus at evening slow final, and Mercury at evening slow: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts and subtract the refined daily difference to obtain the prior segment's daily difference.

sentences.zh: 餘爲初日行分。

translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the initial-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 木、火之夕遲初，土之夕遲，金之晨初，水之晨遲，皆置其後段初日行分，倍其日差減之，後段日差。

translations.literal: Jupiter and Mars evening slow initial, Saturn evening slow, Venus morning initial, Mercury morning slow—all set the subsequent segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract double the daily difference—that is the subsequent segment's daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter and Mars at evening slow initial, Saturn at evening slow, Venus at morning initial, and Mercury at morning slow: set the subsequent segment's initial-day motion parts and subtract double the daily difference to obtain the subsequent segment's daily difference.

sentences.zh: 餘爲末日行分。

translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 木、火、土之夕伏，金、水之晨伏，皆置其前段末日行分，內加其前段日差之半，爲鈦段初日行分，皆與平行分相減，餘爲增減差。

translations.literal: Jupiter, Mars, Saturn evening concealment; Venus and Mercury morning concealment—all set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, inwardly add half the prior segment's daily difference, for next segment's initial-day motion parts; in each case subtract from parallel motion; remainder is increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn at evening concealment and Venus and Mercury at morning concealment: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, inwardly add half the prior segment's daily difference for the next segment's initial-day motion parts; subtract each from parallel motion; the remainder is the increase–decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 木、火之晨退、夕退，置其平行分，退一位、六因之，爲增減差。

translations.literal: Jupiter and Mars morning retrograde and evening retrograde: set their parallel motion, shift back one place and multiply by six for increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter and Mars at morning retrograde and evening retrograde: set parallel motion, shift back one place, multiply by six, and obtain the increase–decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 晨退減爲初，加爲末。

translations.literal: Morning retrograde subtract for initial, add for final.
translations.idiomatic: Morning retrograde: subtract for the initial day and add for the final day.

sentences.zh: 夕退加爲初，減爲末。

translations.literal: Evening retrograde add for initial, subtract for final.
translations.idiomatic: Evening retrograde: add for the initial day and subtract for the final day.

sentences.zh: 晨加夕減，二段相比較。

translations.literal: Morning add and evening subtract—compare the two segments.
translations.idiomatic: Morning adds and evening subtracts—compare the two segments accordingly.

sentences.zh: 金之夕退伏合伏，置其平行分，退一位，三因之折半。

translations.literal: Venus evening retrograde concealment and conjunction concealment: set its parallel motion, shift back one place, triple and halve.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus at evening retrograde concealment and conjunction concealment: set parallel motion, shift back one place, triple, and halve.

sentences.zh: 水之夕退伏合退伏，以平行分折半，各爲增減差。

translations.literal: Mercury evening retrograde concealment and conjunction retrograde concealment: halve the parallel motion; each is increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury at evening retrograde concealment and conjunction retrograde concealment: halve parallel motion; each yields the increase–decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 金之夕退，置其平分，退一位，三在之折半。

translations.literal: Venus evening retrograde: set its parallel motion, shift back one place, triple and halve.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus at evening retrograde: set parallel motion, shift back one place, triple, and halve.

sentences.zh: 水之夕退伏合退伏，以平行分折半，各爲增減差。

translations.literal: Mercury evening retrograde concealment and conjunction retrograde concealment: halve the parallel motion; each is increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury at evening retrograde concealment and conjunction retrograde concealment: halve parallel motion; each yields the increase–decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 金之夕退，置其後段祿日行分，減日差，後段日差。

translations.literal: Venus evening retrograde: set subsequent segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract daily difference—that is subsequent segment daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus at evening retrograde: set the subsequent segment's initial-day motion parts and subtract the daily difference to obtain the subsequent segment's daily difference.

sentences.zh: 爲末日行分。

translations.idiomatic: The result is the final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 金之晨退，置其前段末日行分，減日差，前段日差。

translations.literal: Venus morning retrograde: set prior segment final-day motion parts, subtract daily difference—prior segment daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus at morning retrograde: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts and subtract the daily difference to obtain the prior segment's daily difference.

sentences.zh: 爲初日行分。

translations.idiomatic: The result is the initial-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 皆與平行分相減，餘爲增減差。

translations.literal: In each case subtract from parallel motion; remainder is increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: In each case subtract from parallel motion; the remainder is the increase–decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 凡增減差，倍之爲總差，以相距日率減一除之，爲日差。

translations.literal: For any increase-decrease difference, double it for total difference; divide by the separating day rate minus one for daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: For any increase–decrease difference, double it for the total difference and divide by the separating day rate minus one to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 其初末日行分有其一者，以增減差加減，更求其一，如伏段法，餘依前後平行分相較增減之。

translations.literal: When only one of initial or final day motion parts is known, add or subtract the increase-decrease difference to seek the other, as in the concealment-segment method; the rest follows comparing prior and subsequent parallel motion for increase or decrease.
translations.idiomatic: When only one of the initial or final day motion parts is known, add or subtract the increase–decrease difference to find the other, as in the concealment-segment method; otherwise follow comparing prior and subsequent parallel motion for increase or decrease.

sentences.zh: 金、火之夕遲末，晨遲初，置其段平行分，以相距日率下不倫分乘之，不倫分之秒，與平行之分對。

translations.literal: Venus and Mars evening slow final, morning slow initial: set this segment's parallel motion, multiply by irregular parts beneath the separating day rate; irregular parts' seconds pair with parallel motion's parts.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mars at evening slow final and morning slow initial: set this segment's parallel motion and multiply by the irregular parts under the separating day rate; the irregular parts' arc-seconds pair with the parallel motion's parts.

sentences.zh: 即爲增減差。

translations.idiomatic: The result is the increase–decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 置平行分，夕者以增減差，加爲初日行分，減爲末日行分。

translations.literal: Set parallel motion; for evening segments add the increase-decrease difference for initial-day motion parts and subtract for final-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set parallel motion: for evening segments add the increase–decrease difference for initial-day motion parts and subtract for final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 晨者反是。

translations.idiomatic: For morning segments, the reverse applies.

sentences.zh: 不倫分 金、火星之夕遲末，與晨遲初，其增減差，多於平行分者，爲不倫分也。

translations.literal: Irregular parts: For Venus and Mars evening slow final and morning slow initial, when the increase-decrease difference exceeds the parallel motion, these are irregular parts.
translations.idiomatic: Irregular parts: for Venus and Mars at evening slow final and morning slow initial, when the increase–decrease difference exceeds parallel motion, these are irregular parts.

sentences.zh: 十七日
八十八秒八八五
十六日
八十八秒二三一
十五日
八十七秒四九六
十四日
八十六秒七六一
推五星每日細行，置各段夜半宿次，以初日行分順加退減之，爲次日宿次。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive the five planets' daily fine motion: Set each segment's midnight lodge ordinal; with the initial day's motion parts add in prograde motion and subtract in retrograde—for the next day's lodge ordinal.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the five planets' daily fine motion: set each segment's midnight lodge ordinal and, with the initial day's motion parts, add in prograde motion or subtract in retrograde to obtain the next day's lodge ordinal.

sentences.zh: 又以日差加減其初日行分，爲每日行分，亦順加退減於次日宿次，滿黃道宿次去之，至次段宿次而止，爲每日夜半宿次。

translations.literal: Again add or subtract the daily difference to the initial day's motion parts for daily motion parts; likewise add prograde or subtract retrograde to the next day's lodge ordinal; when full of the ecliptic lodge ordinal discard; continue until the next segment's lodge ordinal—this is each day's midnight lodge ordinal.
translations.idiomatic: Again add or subtract the daily difference to the initial day's motion parts for the daily motion parts; likewise add or subtract prograde or retrograde motion to the next day's lodge ordinal; discard the ecliptic lodge ordinal when full; continue until the next segment's lodge ordinal to obtain each day's midnight lodge ordinal.

sentences.zh: 推五星順逆交宮時刻 視逐日五星細行，與黃道十二宮界宿次同名，其度分又相近者以相減。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive five planets' prograde/retrograde palace-crossing time: Inspect each day's fine planetary motion; when it shares a name with one of the twelve ecliptic palace boundary lodge ordinals and the degrees and parts are also near, subtract them.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the five planets' prograde and retrograde palace-crossing times: inspect each day's fine planetary motion; when it shares a lodge name with an ecliptic twelve-palace boundary and the degrees and parts are near, subtract them.

sentences.zh: 視其餘分，在本日行分以下者，爲交宮在本日也。

translations.literal: Inspect the remaining parts; if below this day's motion parts, palace crossing is on this day.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the remainder: if it falls below this day's motion parts, palace crossing occurs on this day.

sentences.zh: 順行者，以本日夜半星行宿次度分減宮界度分。

translations.literal: For prograde motion, subtract palace-boundary degrees and parts from this day's midnight star-motion lodge ordinal degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For prograde motion, subtract palace-boundary degrees and parts from this day's midnight star-motion lodge degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 退行者，以宮界度分減本日夜半星行宿次度分。

translations.literal: For retrograde motion, subtract this day's midnight star-motion lodge ordinal degrees and parts from palace-boundary degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde motion, subtract this day's midnight star-motion lodge degrees and parts from palace-boundary degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 扣以日周乘之爲實，以本日行分爲法，法除實，得數，依發斂加時法，得交宮時刻。

translations.literal: Multiply by the day circuit for dividend; use this day's motion parts as divisor; divide divisor into dividend; obtain the number; by the emission-collection time-addition method obtain palace-crossing time.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the day circuit for the dividend and use this day's motion parts as divisor; divide to obtain the number, then apply the emission-and-collection time-addition method to obtain the palace-crossing time.

sentences.zh: 推五星伏見凡取伏見，伏者要在已下，見者要在已上。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive five planets' concealment and appearance: In seeking concealment and appearance, concealment must be at si or below; appearance must be at si or above.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the five planets' concealment and appearance: in seeking concealment and appearance, concealment must fall at si or below and appearance at si or above.

sentences.zh: 晨見晨伏者，置其日太陽行度，內減各星行度。

translations.literal: For morning appearance and morning concealment, set that day's solar motion in degrees, inwardly subtract each star's motion in degrees.
translations.idiomatic: For morning appearance and morning concealment, set that day's solar motion in degrees and inwardly subtract each star's motion in degrees.

sentences.zh: 夕見夕伏者，置其日各星行度，內減太陽行度。

translations.literal: For evening appearance and evening concealment, set that day's each star's motion in degrees, inwardly subtract solar motion in degrees.
translations.idiomatic: For evening appearance and evening concealment, set that day's stellar motion in degrees and inwardly subtract solar motion in degrees.

sentences.zh: 即爲其日晨昏伏見度。

translations.literal: This is that day's morning and evening concealment-and-appearance degree.
translations.idiomatic: The result is that day's morning-and-evening concealment-and-appearance degree.

sentences.zh: 置本日伏見度，與次日伏見度相減，餘四而一，即得晨昏伏見分。

translations.literal: Set this day's concealment-and-appearance degree and subtract the next day's; divide the remainder by four to obtain morning and evening concealment-and-appearance parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set this day's concealment-and-appearance degree and subtract the next day's; divide the remainder by four to obtain morning-and-evening concealment-and-appearance parts.

sentences.zh: 視本日伏見度較次日伏見度爲多者減，少者加。

translations.literal: Compare this day's concealment-and-appearance degree with the next day's; subtract if greater, add if less.
translations.idiomatic: Compare this day's concealment-and-appearance degree with the next day's: subtract if greater, add if less.

sentences.zh: 晨者，置本日伏見度，以伏見分加減之，爲晨伏見度。

translations.literal: For morning, set this day's concealment-and-appearance degree and add or subtract the concealment-and-appearance parts—for morning concealment-and-appearance degree.
translations.idiomatic: For morning, set this day's concealment-and-appearance degree and add or subtract the concealment-and-appearance parts to obtain the morning concealment-and-appearance degree.

sentences.zh: 夕者，三因伏見分，置伏見度加減之，爲夕伏見度。

translations.literal: For evening, triple the concealment-and-appearance parts and add or subtract to the concealment-and-appearance degree—for evening concealment-and-appearance degree.
translations.idiomatic: For evening, triple the concealment-and-appearance parts and add or subtract them to the concealment-and-appearance degree to obtain the evening concealment-and-appearance degree.

sentences.zh: 視在各星伏見度上下取之。

translations.literal: Inspect and take according to each star's concealment-and-appearance degree above or below.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect each star's concealment-and-appearance degree and take the value above or below accordingly.

sentences.zh: △步四餘
紫氣週日一萬零二百二十七日一七九二。

translations.literal: Purple Qi's cycle days: 10,227 days 1792 parts.

sentences.zh: 紫氣度率二十八日，日行三分五七一四二九。

translations.literal: Purple Qi's degree rate: 28 days; daily motion 3 parts 571429.
translations.idiomatic: Purple Qi degree rate: 28 days; daily motion 3 parts 571429.

sentences.zh: 紫氣至後策八千一百九十四萬九六二三。
月孛週日三千二百三十一日九六八四。

translations.literal: Moon Comet's cycle days: 3,231 days 9684 parts.

sentences.zh: 月孛度率八日八四八四九二，日行十一分三零一三六一。

translations.literal: Moon Comet's degree rate: 8 days 848492; daily motion 11 parts 301361.
translations.idiomatic: Moon Comet degree rate: 8d 848492 parts; daily motion 11 parts 301361.

sentences.zh: 月孛至後策一千二百二十萬四六五九。
羅計週日六千七百九十三日四四三二。

translations.literal: Rahu and Ketu cycle days: 6,793 days 4432 parts.

sentences.zh: 羅計度率一十八日五九九一零七七六，日行五分三七六六零二。

translations.literal: Rahu and Ketu degree rate: 18 days 59910776; daily motion 5 parts 376602.
translations.idiomatic: Rahu–Ketu degree rate: 18d 59910776 parts; daily motion 5 parts 376602.

sentences.zh: 羅至後策五千三百三十三萬六二一七。
計都至後策一千九百三十六萬九零零一。
推四餘至後策 置中積，加各餘至後策，滿週日去之，即得。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive four residuals' after-solstice tally: Set central accumulation, add each residual's after-solstice tally; when full discard cycle days—to obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the four residuals' after-solstice tallies: set the central accumulation, add each residual's after-solstice tally, and discard the cycle days when full.

sentences.zh: 推四餘周后策 以至後策，減立成內各宿初末度積日，即得。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive four residuals' cycle tally: From after-solstice tally subtract each lodge initial/final-degree accumulated days within the ready reckoner—to obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the four residuals' cycle tallies: subtract each lodge's initial- and final-degree accumulated days in the ready reckoner from the after-solstice tally.

sentences.zh: 推四餘入各宿次初末度積日 置各餘周后策，加入其年冬至分，滿紀法去之，即各餘末度積日。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive four residuals' entry into each lodge initial/final accumulated days: Set each residual's cycle tally, add this year's winter solstice parts; when full discard era rule—this is each residual's final-degree accumulated days.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the four residuals' accumulated days at each lodge's initial and final degrees: set each residual's cycle tally, add this year's winter solstice parts, and discard the era rule when full to obtain each residual's final-degree accumulated days.

sentences.zh: 紫氣、月孛爲各宿初，羅喉、計都爲各宿末。

translations.literal: Purple Qi and Moon Comet are each lodge's initial; Rahu and Ketu are each lodge's final.
translations.idiomatic: Purple Qi and Moon Comet mark each lodge's initial degree; Rahu and Ketu mark each lodge's final degree.

sentences.zh: 氣孛順行，羅計逆行。

translations.literal: Qi and Bo prograde; Rahu and Ketu retrograde.
translations.idiomatic: Purple Qi and Moon Comet move prograde; Rahu and Ketu move retrograde.

sentences.zh: 推四餘初末度積日所入月日 置各餘周后策，加入天正閏餘滿期策減之，起十一月至不滿朔策，即所入月也。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive month and day entered from initial/final accumulated days: Set each residual's cycle tally, add heavenly-standard intercalary remainder, when full subtract period stride, count from eleventh month to what does not fill new-moon stride—that is the month entered.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the month and day entered from initial- and final-degree accumulated days: set each residual's cycle tally, add the heavenly-standard intercalary remainder, subtract the period stride when full, and count from the eleventh month to what falls short of the new-moon stride for the month entered.

sentences.zh: 其初末度積日即滿紀法去者。

translations.literal: Its initial/final accumulated days—when full discard era rule.
translations.idiomatic: For its initial- and final-degree accumulated days, discard the era rule when full.

sentences.zh: 命甲子算外，爲日辰小餘，以發斂求之爲時刻。

translations.literal: Count from jiazi outside the count for day stem-branch and small remainder; seek time by emission-collection.
translations.idiomatic: Count from jiazi outside the count for the day stem-branch and small remainder, and obtain the time by emission-and-collection.

sentences.zh: 視定朔某甲女，即知入月已來日也。

translations.literal: Inspect the fixed new moon's jiazi day—to know days elapsed since month entry.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the fixed new moon's jiazi day to know the days elapsed since entering the month.

sentences.zh: 推四餘每日行度 置各餘初末度積日，氣孛以度率日累加之，至末度加其宿零日及分，即次宿之初度。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive four residuals' daily motion in degrees: Set each residual's initial/final accumulated days; for Qi and Bo accumulate by degree rate day by day; at final degree add that lodge's zero days and parts—for next lodge's initial degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the four residuals' daily motion in degrees: set each residual's initial- and final-degree accumulated days; for Purple Qi and Moon Comet accumulate day by day at the degree rate, and at the final degree add that lodge's zero days and parts to reach the next lodge's initial degree.

sentences.zh: 羅計先加其宿零日及分，後以度率日累加之，即次宿之末度。

translations.literal: For Rahu and Ketu first add that lodge's zero days and parts, then accumulate by degree rate day by day—for next lodge's final degree.
translations.idiomatic: For Rahu and Ketu, first add that lodge's zero days and parts, then accumulate day by day at the degree rate to reach the next lodge's final degree.

sentences.zh: 徊以其大餘，命甲子算外爲日辰。

translations.literal: In each case with its large remainder count from jiazi outside the count for day stem-branch.
translations.idiomatic: In each case, with its large remainder count from jiazi outside the count for the day stem-branch.

sentences.zh: 其交次宿，以小餘以斂爲時刻。

translations.literal: When crossing the next lodge, with small remainder apply collection for the time.
translations.idiomatic: When crossing to the next lodge, apply collection to the small remainder to obtain the time.

sentences.zh: 推四餘交宮 以至後策減各宿交宮積日，餘爲入某宮積中天正閏餘，滿朔策去之，起十一月至不滿朔策，即所入月。

translations.literal: Procedure to derive four residuals' palace crossing: From after-solstice tally subtract each lodge's palace-crossing accumulated days; remainder is accumulated days entering a given palace, heavenly-standard intercalary remainder, when full discard new-moon stride, count from eleventh month to what does not fill new-moon stride—that is month entered.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the four residuals' palace crossing: subtract each lodge's palace-crossing accumulated days from the after-solstice tally; the remainder is the accumulated days entering a given palace; add the heavenly-standard intercalary remainder, discard the new-moon stride when full, and count from the eleventh month to what falls short of the new-moon stride for the month entered.

sentences.zh: 又置入宮積日，加冬至分，滿紀法去之，爲日辰，小餘以斂爲時刻。

translations.literal: Again set palace-entry accumulated days, add winter solstice parts, when full discard era rule for day stem-branch; small remainder by collection for time.
translations.idiomatic: Again set the palace-entry accumulated days, add winter solstice parts, discard the era rule when full for the day stem-branch, and obtain the time from the small remainder by collection.

sentences.zh: 視定朔甲子，即知交宮及時刻。

translations.literal: Inspect fixed new moon jiazi—to know palace crossing and time.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the fixed new moon's jiazi day to know the palace crossing and its time.

sentences.zh: ▲紫氣宿次日分立成入箕初度。

translations.literal: ▲ Purple Qi lodge next-day minute division ready reckoner, entering Ji initial degree.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Purple Qi: lodge-by-lodge daily minute-division ready reckoner, entering the initial degree of Ji.

sentences.zh: 以下表格略
至後策少者用前氐下積日，多者用後氐下積日。

translations.literal: If after-solstice tally is less use the prior Di lower accumulated days; if more use the posterior Di lower accumulated days.
translations.idiomatic: If the after-solstice tally is less, use the prior Di lower accumulated days; if more, use the posterior Di lower accumulated days.
